title: Riverside Custodian: Water on the Basement Floor

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Facilities Work Desk, Campus Services Building

callee.name: Facilities Work Desk
callee.label: Facilities Work Desk, Campus Services Building

transcript.speaker: Custodian
transcript.text: Work desk? This is Luis, early shift at Riverside. I'm down in the basement, by the laundry.

transcript.speaker: Custodian
transcript.text: There's water on the floor. It's about an inch deep, maybe a little more by the washers, and it's spreading. It's heading toward the mechanical room door.

transcript.speaker: Custodian
transcript.text: I heard the phones go off upstairs with that flood warning. Is the creek coming in? Is that what this is?

transcript.speaker: Custodian
transcript.text: There are, uh, three or four students in the laundry room right now with their stuff in the machines. Should I get them out? And the crew's supposed to come down for the filters at seven. What do I tell them?

transcript.speaker: Custodian
transcript.text: Okay. I'll stay by the stairs till somebody gets here. Just tell me quick, all right?

voiceStyles.Custodian: Man in his 50s, calm by nature but uneasy, slightly out of breath from walking, speaking quietly so the students don't hear

instructorNote: Red herring: the stage is about 6.15 ft, well below the 10.5 ft Riverside basement threshold. Watch whether Fac sends someone to check before anyone reports floodwater, and whether Fac and DoS still decide about the laundry room and the 07:00 crew. Only if Fac sends a technician, at about 07:00 read this radio call: "Ops, Tech 2 in the Riverside basement. It's not the creek. The floor drain by washer bank B is backed up with lint, and grey water is coming up out of it. The walls are dry, the mechanical room is dry, and the sump pit is at normal level. I can clear the drain in 20 minutes." Then watch whether the IC logs it as a false lead and the PIO gets the facts to answer the Facebook rumor.
